svg.title: Test-set results by optimizer, 400-step budget
svg.desc: Each dot is one seed; the black tick is the mean over 5 seeds. Grey lines are reference systems. Source: runs/final_*/eval_steps.json and runs/ref/eval.json, commit af156b3.
svg.text: 50 held-out sentences. Each dot is one seed, the black tick is the mean. Lower is better everywhere.
Grey lines: the pretrained model, the real recordings and the vocoder ceiling (real mels through HiFi-GAN).
